summary: Iteration 6 (self sign-up) fully verified. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases pass on POST /api/auth/register (201 w/ guru-forced role, 409 case-insensitive dupe, 422 short password & invalid email, end-to-end register->login->/me->403 on /invoices, seeded keuangan smoke). Frontend (mobile 390x844): go-to-register-button on login navigates to /register which has all 7 required testIDs; inline validation shows 'Password minimal 8 karakter' and 'Konfirmasi password tidak sama'; submit disabled until valid; successful register auto-logs in and lands on Beranda with 'Halo, <name>' greeting, green 'Guru' badge, and Tagihan tab hidden; duplicate email surfaces exact message 'Email sudah terdaftar, silakan masuk'; keuangan login still works and sees Tagihan tab. Test users cleaned up; only seeded accounts remain.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — somewhere in the UI theme/components, legacy shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius are still used. Non-blocking but should be migrated to boxShadow for RN 0.76+. Reference: likely /app/frontend/src/components/ui.* or theme files.

action_items: Optional: migrate deprecated shadow* style props to boxShadow in UI/theme to silence RN warning.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py register handler correctly ignores any client-sent 'role' field (Pydantic model has no role) and always hard-codes 'guru' — matches security requirement.
Duplicate detection relies on Mongo unique index on email + lowercase normalization in both /login and /register; case-insensitive duplicate test passes (409).
Password hashing uses run_in_threadpool — good (bcrypt is CPU-bound).
register.tsx client-side validation (len>=8, confirm match, name/email non-empty) mirrors backend; submit disabled correctly until valid.
seed_data_creation: None. Test created transient users with 'TEST_signup_' / 'test_ui_' email prefix and cleaned them up via fixture + post-run script. Seeded accounts (keuangan@sekolah.id, guru@sekolah.id) untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter6_register.py has an autouse fixture that deletes users matching ^test_signup_.* via MongoClient (MONGO_URL, DB_NAME from env). Browser UI flow uses /register route; backend expects email+name+password only (no role field in RegisterIn).
